description: This file declares the ControlModuleService class and its factory, which implement IPC control module services for the Rialto server. It includes class definitions, method signatures, and external dependencies related to IPC communication, control, and playback services.

classes.name: ControlModuleServiceFactory
classes.description: Factory class for creating instances of ControlModuleService, implementing the IControlModuleServiceFactory interface.

classes.name: ControlModuleService
classes.description: Implements the IPC control module service, handling client connections, shared memory requests, client registration, and acknowledgments.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates and returns a shared pointer to an IControlModuleService, given playback and control services.

methods.name: ControlModuleService
methods.description: Constructor initializing the service with playback and control service references.

methods.name: getSharedMemory
methods.description: Handles request to retrieve shared memory.
